title: NSIR record
description: Neural Semantic Intermediate Representation — the structured record an architecture resolver produces for one tensor. Implemented by `q_nsir::NsirRecord` (crates/q-nsir/src/record.rs); this schema and that struct must agree. Shape follows ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.2.

stack.description: Top-level stack. `Unknown` is a legitimate value, not a failure.

layer.description: Zero-based index within the repeated layer stack. Absent for non-layer tensors (embeddings, final norm, output head).

expert.description: MoE expert index. Present only for `component: MoE`.

operation.description: e.g. `query_projection`, `down_projection`. Empty when the resolver did not recognise the name.

axes.description: Axis labels in tensor axis order. Empty when unresolved — never invented.

role.description: Semantic role. `Unknown` means the resolver read the name and did not recognise it; ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.2 forbids guessing a role from shape.

resolver_id.description: Which architecture plugin produced this record, e.g. `llama`, `generic`.

resolved.description: False when the resolver did not recognise the name. Consumers must surface this rather than papering over it.
